name: corelog-web
description: Aplicaciones web de CoreLog: portal, espacio de trabajo y administración

scripts.build:libs: ng build core && ng build ui && ng build features
scripts.build:all:local: ng build portal --configuration local && ng build workspace --configuration local && ng build admin --configuration local
scripts.build:all:dev: ng build portal --configuration dev && ng build workspace --configuration dev && ng build admin --configuration dev
scripts.build:all:qa: ng build portal --configuration qa && ng build workspace --configuration qa && ng build admin --configuration qa
scripts.build:all:vps: ng build portal --configuration vps && ng build workspace --configuration vps && ng build admin --configuration vps
scripts.build:all:prod: ng build portal --configuration production && ng build workspace --configuration production && ng build admin --configuration production
scripts.test:apps: ng test portal --watch=false && ng test workspace --watch=false && ng test admin --watch=false
scripts.test:all: npm run test:core && npm run test:ui && npm run test:features && npm run test:apps
